reviews.text: My dogs looked beautiful and they were happy

I took my 5.5 month puppy there and it was not the best haircut but i understand if my puppy was being fidgety. He is a long haired dog. They half trimed his body and cut his nails, and did bathe him. His face was left untouched.  When i asked questions about his experience, the groomer seemed annoyed by my simple, "how was he?" question. The groomer answered very defensivly when i was just trying to understand the process. Afterwards when I asked for tips to help him out for future groomings, they replied with, "get him sedated", and that just didnt sit right with me, after all my dog is still just a puppy. Perhaps this place is better suited for well behaved and regular ongoing dogs.

I love this location! They’re all so welcoming and sweet. First visit was yesterday, Rose did an awesome job on my new dog. Thanks a lot 💜 …

I was forced to board my dog here after my sitter cancelled last minute. I’ll start by saying that he was treated well. However the employees are absolutely terrible. The ONLY advertised price they have for boarding is listed on THEIR own website and I was never told what the price would be when dropping off my dog. When I went to pick him up they gave me a completely different price than what was advertised. When I mentioned this, all the employees gave me attitude saying that they don’t have access to change it online. They kept saying I should have asked, when in reality they should be aware they have a falsely advertised their prices and I should have been made aware of that. Or at least have their prices listed at the counter, which they do not. They kept saying how they fed my dog and he was treated well as if they were doing me a favor. This is the obvious expectation and what I’m paying them for. They blamed me for not doing research prior to dropping off my dog which I did by reading all the information ON THEIR OWN WEBSITE. I have no problem paying x5 what i did but I dont think anyone appreciates being lied to expecting one price and being given another. They are clearly at fault yet tried blaming me for their mistake. When they were told they lost a customer, they replied with ‘we have plenty of business and don’t need yours’. Needless to say they practice shady business and I won’t be coming back. This would have ended on a much more positive note as I had cash in pocket ready to tip them. Unfortunately they chose not to honor their listed price and deferred responsibility.
They always take care of my dog Peter whenever he gets groomed. Friendly staff. Love it here.

I had been coming here for years since its close to my house. However, yesterday when I picked up my dogs, I noticed one of them couldn't open one of her eyes. I immediately called the store and talked to the groomer, she said that my dog was fine (she was not!)and it was just a hair in her eye. My dog was clearly in pain and wouldn't let anyone come close to her eye. I decided to take her to the emergency vet. The emergency vet diagnosed her with a corneal ulcer caused by poor handling while grooming. Her eye is still a bit swollen.

I tried to talk to the owner and I asked for an email to send the vet paperwork but I was given a phony email. DO NOT TAKE YOUR DOGS HERE.
